resources.string: The AI service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.

Could not reach the AI service. Check your connection and try again.
The wallet changed while this AI request was running. Its answer is not shown here, and the request may have been charged to the other wallet\'s AI account.
ZCHAT could not open the encrypted storage of your AI chats and settings. Nothing was deleted. Close ZCHAT and open it again. If it keeps happening, restart your phone.
ZCHAT is still opening your wallet. Tap Retry in a moment.
ZCHAT\'s AI service cannot sign this wallet in yet. Try again later.
Too many AI sign-in attempts from this network. Try again later.
ZCHAT cannot open another new AI account from this network right now. Try again later.
The AI service did not accept this wallet\'s sign-in. Try again later.
This wallet\'s AI account was just opened on another phone. Tap Retry to use it here.
The AI account this phone used before is one that ZCHAT could not match to this wallet, and it held no paid credit. ZCHAT opened this wallet\'s own AI account.

This phone holds a key to an AI account that may hold paid credit and that ZCHAT cannot match to this wallet. ZCHAT keeps the key and does not use it. This wallet has its own AI account. If that credit is yours, write to ZCHAT support: after a check of the wallet it belongs to, Try to link opens it. If support had to remove someone else\'s sign-in key from that account, use Look for AI credit from before 2.13 instead.

This phone\'s key to its AI account no longer works, and this recovery phrase is not linked to that account. ZCHAT opened a new AI account. Credit of the earlier account is not deleted: it stays on ZCHAT\'s server.
This AI account is no longer linked to your recovery phrase. This phone\'s key still opens it. Link again asks ZCHAT\'s server to link it.
This wallet\'s recovery phrase already had an AI account. ZCHAT now uses that one; the trial account this phone used before is left.

This wallet has two AI accounts that may hold paid credit. This phone uses one of them; your recovery phrase opens the other. ZCHAT support can join them into one after a check that this wallet is yours. Until then keep this phone\'s app data: its key is the only way to the account it uses.
A key this phone kept for another AI account no longer works, so ZCHAT removed it. If that credit is yours, Look for AI credit from before 2.13 is the way to it.
This AI account is linked to your recovery phrase again.
ZCHAT\'s server did not link this AI account to your recovery phrase. This phone\'s key still opens it.
The AI account this phone kept a key for is now this wallet\'s AI account.
Look for AI credit from before 2.13

This sends ZCHAT\'s server a code made from this wallet\'s chat address together with this wallet\'s AI sign-in key, to find AI credit you had before. Older versions sent the same code when they first used AI.
ZCHAT\'s server found no AI credit from before 2.13 that it can open for this wallet.
ZCHAT found this wallet\'s earlier AI account and linked it to your recovery phrase.

ZCHAT\'s server has an AI account from before 2.13 for this wallet that may hold paid credit. It is still tied to the phone that used it: open ZCHAT 2.13 or newer on that phone once. If that phone is gone, write to ZCHAT support: after a check that this wallet is yours, this button opens the account.
ZCHAT\'s server found an earlier AI account for this wallet, and this wallet\'s current AI account may hold paid credit too. ZCHAT support can join the two after a check that this wallet is yours.
Top-ups work only for an AI account that is linked to this wallet\'s recovery phrase. This one is not.
